elasticsearch.validation: Local HTTP mock only; no live cluster or performance comparison
elasticsearch.finalTargetedTests: ElasticsearchIndexTest (5) + SegmentReaderTest (1): 6 tests passed on both Java 17 and Java 21; includes bounded capture/FINAL bulk, partial item failure before SSE, literal matching, sparse keyset paging, fixed watermarks, source hydration, and cross-segment read order
elasticsearch.bulkWrite: At most 100 actions and 8 MiB pending per batch; singleton and byte-overflow actions use single-document PUT; FINAL and telemetry flush before corresponding SSE; validates response item count and each item result; deterministic document IDs make explicit replay idempotent
elasticsearch.jsonlHydration: SQLite and Elasticsearch page hydration group pointers by segment and use one short-lived read-only FileChannel per segment per page
elasticsearch.pagination: No from/size offsets; seq keyset with limit+1, fixed through watermark, and index sorting; mock asserts bounded request shape

sqlite.historyRebuild: Existing JSONL-to-SQLite history recovery and 100000-record paging tests passed in both reactors
sqlite.selectedByDefault: SQLite remains the default; existing schema, HistoryRepository and JSONL rebuild paths retained
